title: Patch Submission
description: What the PATCHER emits, one object per attempted fix. Contains no answer-key material - this schema is SAFE TO MIRROR into the harness repo as the agent-facing contract.

target_sha.description: Commit of the working copy the patches apply to.

source_finding_id.description: The scanner candidate finding this patch responds to. The scorer joins on file+line via this, NOT on any challenge identifier - the patcher never sees challenge keys.

file.description: Repo-relative path in the working copy.

vulnerability_class.description: Codes the patcher believes it is fixing. Must be asserted by the patcher, never inherited from a lane list.

diff.description: Unified diff, applies cleanly to target_sha with `git apply`. The patch itself is the deliverable; the working copy is not mutated in place.

rationale.description: Why this change removes the vulnerability.

functional_risk.description: What the patcher believes could break, and why it thinks it will not.

self_test.description: Optional patcher-authored proof. Recorded as evidence, weighted low - the party that produced the fix is not a trusted verifier of it.
